information: This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png) This competition is sponsored by [GAN Cube](https://www.gancube.com/)! ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjE2ODc1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--c49943c9c18d14934e468ae44d3ef16356f9785e/GAN_logo_.jpg) - [West Coast Cubing LLC](https://www.westcoastcubing.com) presents another Bay Area competition! - **This competition will have dual rounds of 3x3! This means that you will be guaranteed to advance to the second round.** - *If we run ahead of schedule, we will start first round events no earlier than 20 minutes, so please show up at least 20 minutes before your first event.* - We will be assigning judging assignments to competitors for the group before or after their own competing groups. Please check your personal competitor cards when we assign them a week before the competition date for relevant info. - Competitors and spectators under the age of 18 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian. - West Coast Cubing does not provide supervision and cannot assume responsibility for personal safety or belongings.
